notes: Large drug manufacturing facility (injectables including carboplatin injection and oral tablets including amitriptyline hydrochloride tablets USP 100 mg) cited for pervasive data-integrity failures (destroyed/torn CGMP records, uncontrolled manual chromatographic integration, missing raw data), inadequate laboratory controls and OOS handling, inadequate process validation, and environmental-monitoring/aseptic-processing (Grade A ISO 5, RABS smoke studies) deficiencies. is_sterile_product and sterility/aseptic_processing categories reflect the ISO 5/RABS aseptic-filling operations described alongside the oral solid-dose line.
